resources.string: Join Weekly to create your challenge profile first.
This board needs an updated challenge service.
Joining shares your name and habit totals for this period with other participants. No diary entries, weight, or calorie amounts are shared.
Earn one point per habit each day: movement, food logging, nutrition goal, and water goal.
Earn a bonus point on days with three or more habits.
Your longest run of days with two or more habits earns one point for each day after the first.
This removes your scores for this time period only. Your other challenges and diary stay unchanged.
Your public profile, all scores, and challenge reports will be deleted. Your private diary stays on this device.

The selected score comes first. Ties favor more different habits, steadier results across habits, and the other day counts. If those match, the person who reached them first ranks higher. Workout calories do not break ties.
Joining Weekly also shares your scores on the Daily and Monthly boards. You can leave either board separately.
